summary: Iteration 26: frontend-only test of the offline Playgama build at /pgtest/index.html (build dated 13:35, after the latest harbour.js). Tested at 1920x1080 and 390x844 using fresh contexts plus one seeded save (/app/tests/pg_seed.js). WORKING: all 7 signposts show their prompt (Tackle Shop, Sea Serpent · Travel, Quest Board, Hall of Achievements, Pearl Shop, Anchor Café · Contracts, Old Salt's Almanac) and each opens a page with no JS errors. Quest Board: 3 daily and 2 weekly quests are active with progress (d_water 4/5 and w_catch 4/50 after 4 catches). 'Casting Off' goes Accept -> active -> Completed, its reward is paid (+2 pearls) and 'The Miller's Complaint' unlocks. Achievements: First Blood unlocks after the first catch, +25 gold is paid, it shows 1/42 and survives a reload. Contracts: 6 offers, Accept works up to 3 (the 4th is disabled with 'slots are full'). Delivering without enough fish gives the toast 'You need 3 more Bluegill in your keepnet'. Delivering with the right fish removes it from the keepnet, pays +50 gold, +20 XP and 1 pearl, removes the contract, completes daily 'Honest Work' and shows the toast 'Contract filled...'. Swap (reroll) and Abandon work. Almanac: My Catches shows the curve, the water bar and the heaviest fish. Conditions shows a species select and time-of-day, weather and hour bars. Price History and Crates show empty states without crashing. Quest, achievement and contract state survive a reload. Regression: fishing, selling from the catch card (d_sell advanced), travel to Millbrook and back, and the tutorial (step 1 -> 2, then skip) all work. 390x844 has no horizontal overflow. There were 0 /api/ requests to the app origin (only api.playgama.com bridge timestamp). FAILING: (1) CRITICAL: when a quest completes during a catch, sale or travel, the response's interceptor crashes. The player sees the toast 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'gold')', the catch popup never shows and no quest toast appears. (2) HIGH: the Pearl Shop route renders the placeholder PearlShopSoon ('Outfits arrive soon'), not the real PearlShop. No portraits, colours or frames are shown, so buying and equipping cannot be tested. (3) No toast ever shows for a new achievement. (4) The 'Show' badge button on an unlocked achievement returns 'That's part of the online version'.

ui_bugs.component: offline quests_done payload vs api.js interceptor
ui_bugs.issue: harbour.js event() does done.push(q.name), so quests_done is an array of strings. tfl/lib/api.js:25-29 reads q.reward.gold and throws a TypeError, so axios rejects the /fish/land (and /inventory/sell, /waters/travel) promise. Reproduced twice: with a seeded 'Casting Off' at 2/3, the 3rd catch showed the toast 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'gold')' and no catch popup. The fish and the reward were saved, but the player never sees the catch or the quest toast. Fix: push {name: q.name, kind: q.kind || 'story', reward: q.reward} (the reward has gold, xp and pearls).

App.js:21 does `import PearlShop from './world/PearlShopSoon'`, so /game/pearl-shop shows 'Outfits / Rod Skins / Pets / Emotes — Outfits arrive soon'. The real tfl/pages/game/PearlShop.js (data-testid pearl-shop-page, shop-portraits-grid, shop-colours, shop-frames) is never mounted, and the offline /cosmetics routes are never called. Blocks all Pearl Shop test items: balance, portraits, colours, frames, the 'too expensive' message, buy and equip. Fix: use tfl/pages/game/PearlShop when OFFLINE (or for both builds).

land() and sell() return new_achievements, but nothing in the frontend reads that field. The only grep hit is the quests_done handler in api.js. GET /achievements always returns new: []. First Blood unlocks silently (gold +25 with no toast). Fix: add a toast for r.data.new_achievements in the api.js interceptor, or in the offline adapter.

badge-pin-<id> is visible on unlocked achievements. It posts /achievements/badges, which has no offline route, so the toast says 'That's part of the online version'. Hide [data-testid^=badge-pin-] offline, or add a route.

The UI shows 'Hand in N now' (partial hand-in) when you have some but not all of the fish. Offline deliver requires the full qty and returns 'You need X more ...'. Either support partial delivery offline (progress plus remove the fish) or relabel the button.
Shows 'due in 0m' because offline contracts have deadline: null. Hide the due label or set a deadline (e.g. endOf(1)).
contract-market-* is visible offline, but there is no Market page offline. Add it to the CSS hide list.

integration_issues.issue: contractAct deliver calls event('contract') but does not return ev.quests_done. The quest completes and pays silently, with no toast. Once item 1 is fixed, return quests_done in the deliver response.
In server.js land(), HB.event('catch') (which runs checkAch) is called before stats.heaviest_kg is updated. 'Heavy Hands' and similar unlock one catch late. Move the heaviest update above HB.event.

issues: Almanac header shows the 'Angler Pass' badge and copy about 'Market prices' and 'server-wide' tables. Conditions says '1 landings server-wide'.
Contracts intro: 'Four dockside patrons ... bought on the Market'. The 'Angler Pass' tag appears next to free swaps.
Achievements intro: 'Press Show on up to 3 earned badges to put them on your profile'.
Pearl Shop placeholder lists 'Tournaments' and 'Login chest' as pearl sources; neither exists offline.

design_issues.screen: Almanac > Best Conditions with no catches
issues: Empty body with no empty-state text. My Catches has one ('Nothing in your log yet...').
Escape did not close the harbour page modal in desktop runs; modal-close-btn works.
At 390x844 the toast sits over the modal header and covers the close X for about 4 s.

action_items: CRITICAL harbour.js event(): quests_done must be objects {name, kind, reward:{gold,xp,pearls}}, not strings. Currently it crashes the api.js interceptor and hides the catch popup.

App.js: mount tfl/pages/game/PearlShop (not world/PearlShopSoon) in the offline build, then verify portraits, colours and frames, buying (including 'You need N more Pearls'), equipping, and that friend slots, rename and walls stay hidden.
Show a toast for new_achievements (from land, sell and contract deliver responses).
Contracts offline: support partial hand-in or change the 'Hand in N now' label; fix 'due in 0m'; return quests_done from deliver.
server.js land(): update stats.heaviest_kg before HB.event('catch').
Optional: rewrite online-only copy (Angler Pass, Market, server-wide, Tournaments, Login chest) for offline.
critical_code_review_comments: harbour.js and api.js disagree on the quests_done shape (string vs object). The offline adapter should return the same response shapes as the online server.

Contract 'dismiss' only filters offers, but the UI only shows Dismiss ('Clear') on filled DoneCards. Offline deletes filled contracts at once, so Dismiss can never be reached in the offline UI. That is harmless, but the review request's 'Dismiss works' item cannot be tested.
offers() refills to 6 right away after Accept. Online, an accepted order's spot is re-posted hours later. This is fine with DAILY_CAP 8, but the intro copy no longer matches.

success_rate.frontend: ~70%: signposts, quest progress, contracts, almanac, persistence and regression pass. Quest-complete-on-catch crashes. Pearl Shop is not wired. Achievement toast is missing.

seed_data_creation: pg_seed.js (run in page after opening Contracts once, then reload): Casting Off active 2/3, 2 Bluegill + 1 Fathead Minnow in keepnet, accepted contracts kseed1 (1x Bluegill) and kseed5 (5x Bluegill), 10 pearls, tutorial done.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use exec(open(f).read(), globals()) for /app/tests/pg_helpers.py and /app/tests/pg_harbour.py (without globals() the functions are not defined). open_spot(page, id) teleports __fx.me to the signpost and clicks spot-prompt. Close pages with [data-testid=modal-close-btn]. Return to the harbour from water with __fx.openSpot('harbour'). bridge.storage.get returns already-parsed objects. Capture toasts with a MutationObserver (OBS snippet in this iteration's scripts), because sonner toasts disappear before polling sees them. Duel Pier is not built; do not test it.
